note: USACE park on the west side of 13,000-acre Harlan County Lake, 2.5 mi east of Alma. Mostly shaded; paved main road, gravel back-in spurs. The west non-electric loop sits on open lawn at the shore; the electric loops are behind the shore road. Attendant on duty May-Sept; boat ramp, fish-cleaning station by the entrance, two marinas on the lake's east end. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov: $18 non-electric / $30-34 50-amp electric (2026 peak), 133 sites with 91 bookable in the catalog (all take 45 ft+), 50-amp + water + sewer sites, showers, flush and vault toilets, water, dump. Added the weekend 2 / holiday 3-night minimums, the 14-in-30 limit and the May 1 - Sept 30 booking season. Lakefront confirmed from plotted site coordinates. Note cleaned. Campground season outside the booking window not stated.
flags: Waterfront (no change, lakefront confirmed): rec.gov site coordinates on imagery put the west non-electric loop's sites 006, 007, 009, 015 and 017 on open mowed lawn running straight to the riprap shore, 20-40 m from the water with no road, driveway or day-use area between (015 sits at the base of the jetty). The shore-row electric sites 039-056 are lakeview only: the paved shore road runs between their pads and the riprap. Sites 057/058 sit south of that road on the point by the fishing pier.
Pin OK: stored 40.0850,-99.3280 is inside the west loop by sites 003/005; rec.gov's facility point is 40.0869,-99.3156 (east end); the site centroid is 40.0844,-99.3247.

Season: recreation.gov prices and books only May 1 - Sept 30 (2026-2028; a one-off April 2024 'Transition' season existed). Whether the park is open first-come outside that is not stated; the Corps' own Harlan County pages (nwk.usace.army.mil) returned 'Access Denied' and were not retried. Campground season left unset.
recreation.gov lists a militaryDiscount rule (value 1) for this facility; not written (discounts not in this result).
The 2024+ lake level looks normal on imagery: water at the riprap along the whole campground shore.
